runtime_constraint: C1-C4 must derive the canonical entity by PARSING runtime-visible identity records. Reading canonical identity from _oracle_metadata is permitted only in C5/C6, which are ceilings and never production arms.
state_constraint: Both the original subject surface AND the resolved canonical entity must be retained. Replacing one with the other reproduces the measured forgotten-subject defect.
